invariants.rationale: The method returns an object constructed by a helper, so it should never be null if the helper behaves correctly.
HoodieWriteMetadata#getWriteStats should return a non-null value, as it is tied to the output of the write operation.
Partition write stats are expected to be initialized for commit metadata.
The resulting write metadata should contain a non-null collection of write statuses.
Write metadata is expected to track write errors, thus this collection should be non-null
